$comment: Maps the original Canva content-hashed filenames to readable paths.
SOURCE OF TRUTH for scripts/fetch-assets.sh - edit this file, then re-run the script.
Every entry below was VERIFIED by rendering the asset from the live CDN in a browser
and looking at it. This is no longer guesswork.
KEY FINDING: the neon script headings ('About me', 'Mediakit', 'Playlist Placement',
'Get in Touch', 'Meditations') are NOT images. They are live text set in Amsterdam One
with a CSS glow. The rebuild renders them as real <h2> text - no asset needed.
WATCH OUT: several Canva PNGs are SPRITE SHEETS with multiple frames side by side. logo-keyring is 2400x800 = 3 frames. If an image renders as repeated copies of itself, that is why - crop it.
warning: Only fetchable while the original Canva site is still live. Run scripts/fetch-assets.sh BEFORE taking it down.
